title: Global Federated Learning Strategies for Building Efficient Personalized Models
abstract: arXiv:2608.15107v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Federated learning (FL) is a practical framework that can train models on distributed user data while guaranteeing data privacy; however, due to heterogeneity in which each user has a different data distribution, problems frequently arise where both global and personalization performance deteriorate simultaneously. This dissertation presents methodologies for building efficient personalized models by identifying which strategies are effective in the global training stage and by showing how to preserve global knowledge while securing user-specific performance during local adaptation. translated_title: 面向高效个性化模型的全局联邦学习策略
translated_abstract: 联邦学习（FL）是一种实用框架，可以在保证数据隐私的同时，在分布式用户数据上训练模型；然而，由于每个用户的数据分布不同导致的异构性，常常会出现全局性能和个性化性能同时恶化的问题。本论文提出了构建高效个性化模型的方法，通过识别全局训练阶段中有效的策略，并展示如何在本地适应过程中保留全局知识的同时确保用户特定性能。首先，我们表明随着数据异构性的增加，特征向量的崩溃比分类器权重更根本的瓶颈，并提出一种直接缓解本地与全局模型之间表示幅度差异的方法。其次，我们分析了一种加强本地对齐的训练方法可以引发遗忘现象。
tldr: 本论文提出在联邦学习中通过缓解特征向量崩溃和保留全局知识，实现高效个性化模型构建的策略。
en_tdlr: This dissertation proposes strategies for building efficient personalized models in federated learning by mitigating feature collapse and preserving global knowledge.
